settings.lang.template.hint: A file with every string: the value is the English text, the Russian one is next to it. Once the values are translated and _meta is filled in, the file works as a custom translation.

settings.autostart.label: Start with Windows (in tray)
settings.autostart.hint_process: Optimization starts together with the app.
settings.autostart.hint_service: Optimization starts without the app too.
settings.autostart.journal_on: Start with Windows turned on (in tray)
settings.autostart.journal_off: start with Windows turned off in “Settings”
settings.autostart.undo_already: start with Windows is already off
settings.autostart.undo_changed: autostart entry was changed after DpiShell
settings.run_mode.hint_service: Works without the window; usually starts by itself after a restart (if not, see “Diagnostics”).
settings.run_mode.hint_process: Optimization works while the app is open (in the window or in the tray).
settings.run_mode.busy_service: Switching to running without the window…
settings.run_mode.busy_process: Switching to running from the app…
settings.close.title: When the window is closed
settings.router.show_hint: Off: the router is not searched for or shown, and the window works as if there were none.
settings.advanced.title: Advanced tools
settings.advanced.hint: This is “Connection debugging” in “Games & apps”: recording an app’s connections and saving a profile.
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.router.forget_tip: Erase the saved router password from this PC
settings.changes.promise: Values from before DpiShell will be restored. Your later changes are kept.
settings.changes.helper_missing: Helper is not installed — its records of system settings are not shown.
settings.changes.helper_lost: Helper is not responding — its records are not shown now.
settings.changes.helper_old: The helper is outdated and keeps no log — update it in “About & updates”.
settings.changes.confirm:
Undo all DpiShell changes?

settings.changes.summary: Restored: {restored} · already as before: {same} · skipped: {skipped} · failed: {failed}
settings.changes.question: The “skipped” items were changed after DpiShell by you or another app. If needed, restore them manually.
settings.cleanup.title: Cleanup and removal
settings.cleanup.clear_history_hint: Strategy search results, statistics and logs. My sites and found strategies are kept.
settings.cleanup.remove_service_hint: Removes the service and the WinDivert driver, restores the changed Windows settings. To bring it back, use “Turn on” on Home.
settings.cleanup.uninstall_helper_hint: The helper makes changes with administrator rights. Without it the app is view-only; at the first action you will be offered to install it again (one permission prompt).
settings.remove_service.confirm_service: Remove the optimization service and the WinDivert driver? Optimization will stay off until the next “Turn on”.
settings.remove_service.confirm_process: Remove the optimization service and the WinDivert driver? If optimization is on, it will turn off until the next “Turn on”.
settings.history.confirm:
Delete strategy search results, statistics and logs?
My sites, found strategies and the running optimization are kept.
settings.transfer.title: My settings
settings.transfer.row: My sites, strategies, game profiles, DNS
settings.transfer.hint: A folder or a .zip archive of text files, one per section. Can be shared — for example, with subscribers of the same ISP.
settings.transfer.export_intro: A folder or a .zip archive of text files, one per section.
settings.transfer.helper_old: A newer helper is needed — update it (“About & updates”).
settings.transfer.helper_missing: Settings cannot be read or written without the helper.
settings.transfer.warn_hosts_out: hosts lines redirect site addresses. Export them only if you are sure of them.
settings.transfer.warn_dns_out: A custom DNS server sees requests and can alter answers. Export it only if you trust it.
settings.transfer.warn_hosts_in: hosts lines redirect site addresses — this is how fake pages are served. Import them only from people you trust.
settings.transfer.warn_dns_in: A custom DNS server sees requests and can alter answers. Import it only from people you trust.
settings.transfer.never: Never exported: proxy, router password, history, statistics, addresses of this PC, logs.
settings.transfer.import_intro: Choose a folder or a .zip archive with settings — what will change is shown before anything is written.
settings.transfer.promise: Recorded in “DpiShell changes” — “Undo all” restores the previous state.
settings.transfer.empty_pkg: Nothing to import in the package.
settings.transfer.import_nochange: No changes: everything from the package is already there.
settings.checkdns.title: Site addresses for checks
settings.checkdns.secure_hint: The result does not depend on the ISP’s DNS. If secure DNS does not answer, addresses come from the system — this is noted in the result.
settings.checkdns.system_hint: Secure DNS is not used at all — for networks where it is blocked and for sites known only to the network’s DNS. DNS spoofing by the ISP will show up as “site does not open”.
settings.checkdns.note_system: Addresses for the check were taken from the system.
settings.checkdns.note_fallback: Secure DNS did not answer — addresses were taken from the system.
settings.checkdns.frag_system: site addresses were taken from the system
settings.checkdns.frag_fallback: secure DNS did not answer — site addresses were taken from the system
